2025_investment_review_memo.pdf.1:
1. Business Overview
The target operates an industrial-supplies distribution platform. Consolidated revenue for FY2024 was KRW 124.0 billion, up 18% year over year. Key customers are construction firms and their subcontractors; the top 10 accounts represent 42% of revenue. The company directly operates three logistics centers in the Seoul metropolitan area.
2025_investment_review_memo.pdf.2:
2. Financial Position
As of year-end 2024, the debt-to-equity ratio stands at 156%, below the industry average (180%). The operating margin is 6.8%, and EBITDA reached KRW 11.8 billion. Receivables turnover is 87 days, on the long side for a distributor. Reliance on borrowings is 31%.
2025_investment_review_memo.pdf.3:
3. Risk Factors
A construction-market downturn poses revenue risk. Customer concentration is high, so the loss of a major account would swing results materially. One of the three logistics-center leases expires in 2026, and renewal terms may raise logistics costs.

2025_due_diligence_summary.pdf.1:
Due Diligence Summary
Legal review found two pending lawsuits, both routine commercial disputes; contingent liabilities are assessed below KRW 0.3 billion. Tax diligence found no exceptions over the past three years.
